evals.prompt: Run SAST on the changes in my current feature branch before I open the PR.
evals.expected_output: A SARIF report written to .vulnetix/sast.<timestamp>.sarif covering files changed vs origin/main, rendered as a severity-grouped table.
expectations: Determines scope as files changed since `git merge-base origin/main HEAD` when `--paths` is not provided
Runs `vulnetix sast --paths "$PATHS" -o json-sarif` and writes the report to `.vulnetix/sast.${TIMESTAMP}.sarif`
Renders findings table with columns Severity | Rule | File:Line | Message | Source, grouped from critical → low
Writes a `.vulnetix/sast/<branch>.summary.yaml` with finding counts so `pr-security-reviewer agent` can consume it
Suggests `secure-code-write` when the same rule fires repeatedly

evals.prompt: Did we just introduce an XXE pattern? Check rule VNX-XXE-001 against src/parsers/.
evals.expected_output: A targeted SAST run scoped to src/parsers/ filtering on the VNX-XXE-001 rule, with file:line hits or a clean-pass message.
expectations: Passes `--rule-id VNX-XXE-001` through to the `vulnetix sast` invocation
Scopes the scan to `--paths src/parsers/` rather than the full branch diff
Produces SARIF output and renders the table sorted by severity
If no findings, returns a clean-pass message instead of an empty table
Does not silently invoke Semgrep unless both `binaries.semgrep: true` and `repo.semgrep_config: true` are present in `.vulnetix/capabilities.yaml`

evals.prompt: Augment Vulnetix SAST with our own .semgrep rules across the diff and give me one merged report.
evals.expected_output: A merged SARIF where Vulnetix findings and local Semgrep findings are de-duped by file:line:rule, with a Source column distinguishing the two engines.
expectations: Reads `.vulnetix/capabilities.yaml` and verifies BOTH `binaries.semgrep: true` AND `repo.semgrep_config: true` before augmenting
De-duplicates findings across both sources by the key `<file>:<line>:<rule_id>`
Adds a `Source` column to the rendered table distinguishing Vulnetix vs Semgrep origins
If either capability flag is false, silently runs Vulnetix rules only and notes it
